name: 家长会发言稿 · 学科老师版
description_zh: 为教师生成学科老师家长会发言稿（含开场、班/学情通报、家庭教育建议、Q&A 预案、PPT 大纲），按时长换算字数预算，遵守不公布排名、不点名批评等纪律红线。触发关键词：家长会发言稿、家长会讲话、学科老师家长会、家长会演讲。
description_en: Generates a subject-teacher parent-meeting speech (including opening, class/learning-status report, family-education advice, Q&A preparation, and PPT outline), budgeting word count by duration, and respecting red lines such as not disclosing rankings or naming individual students for criticism. Trigger keywords: parent meeting speech, parent meeting talk, subject-teacher parent meeting, parent meeting presentation.
